verdict.rationale: The Kimi help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) as a general assistant feature, so the product documents its own scheduling capability. The evidence is only a single index-level mention, with no detail on whether tasks can recur, how schedules are set, or whether multi-step workflows are supported. Missing for 10: confirmation of recurring (vs one-off) schedules, documentation of schedule configuration and workflow scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
